catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy validation pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP v5b and EMA SmPC checked. Shared indications retained; new detailed eligibility rules are breast-specific. Source conflicts are explicit and do not generate automatic doses.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00588 Version 5b. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Maintenance treatment of adults with advanced FIGO stage III-IV BRCA1/2-mutated high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

Maintenance treatment of adults with platinum-sensitive relapsed BRCA-mutated high-grade serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.
Monotherapy for adults with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and germline and/or somatic BRCA1/2 mutations who progressed after prior therapy including a new hormonal agent.
indications.additional_treatment_requirement: Continue medical castration with an LHRH analogue in patients who are not surgically castrated.

indications.description: Monotherapy or combination with endocrine therapy for adjuvant treatment of adults with germline BRCA1/2-mutated HER2-negative high-risk early breast cancer previously treated with neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy.
Maintenance monotherapy for adults with germline BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas without progression after at least 16 weeks of platinum treatment in a first-line regimen.
Maintenance treatment of germline BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma without progression after first-line platinum.
BRCA-mutated first-line or platinum-sensitive relapsed maintenance treatment.
BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer after a new hormonal agent, under NCCP 00588g (not any HRR alteration).

administration_instructions: Do not chew, crush, dissolve, or divide.
May be taken with or without food.
If a dose is missed, take the next normal dose at the scheduled time.

tnbc_neoadjuvant.required: Residual invasive cancer in breast or resected lymph nodes after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

any: Node-negative disease with primary tumour >=2 cm pathologically

hr_positive_her2_negative_neoadjuvant.required: No pathological complete response and CPS+EG score >=3.

hr_positive_her2_negative_adjuvant.required: At least four pathologically confirmed positive lymph nodes.

eligibility.breast_start_window_recommendation: Ideally initiate within 12 weeks of last surgery, chemotherapy or radiation; later starts require specialist review, not an automatic contraindication.

exclusions: Previous treatment with a PARP inhibitor
Pregnancy for ovarian, breast, and pancreatic indications
Breastfeeding during treatment and for 1 month after the last dose for ovarian, breast, and pancreatic indications

baseline: Confirm germline and/or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation using an accurate validated method

baseline_conditional.condition: Premenopausal woman with ovarian, breast, or pancreatic indication

regular_conditional.condition: Ovarian, breast, or pancreatic indication where clinically indicated

monitoring.disease_monitoring: According to treatment plan and supervising Consultant.
agent_specific_notes: Monthly FBC for the first 12 months and periodically thereafter if treatment continues (EMA4.4). NCCP specifies FBC, renal and liver profile every 4 weeks for12 months, then as clinically indicated.

No routine olaparib-specific echo, ECG, DXA, tumour-marker or CT interval is mandated. Add tests for another treatment or clinical indication, without importing an ovarian trial scan schedule into adjuvant breast care.
Interrupt for severe blood toxicity; persistent abnormal counts after a four-week interruption require marrow/cytogenetic investigation.
Breast duration is up to 1 year. Ovarian/prostate/pancreatic duration remains indication-specific.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Display every source-linked finding; the most restrictive action governs. Source conflicts suppress automatic numeric doses.

action.message: The entered ANC and platelet values meet NCCP on-treatment thresholds. Continue the previous prescribed dose only if other assessed domains permit; this does not reset an existing reduction.

action.message: Delay olaparib for ANC <1 or platelets <100 ×10⁹/L until recovery, then restart one level lower per NCCP Table 1. Check prior reductions and occurrence history; the fourth occurrence requires cessation.
action.recommendation: No dose now; after recovery, use the next lower verified dose level (300 → 250 → 200 mg twice daily). Confirm prior reductions and occurrence history with the Consultant.

action.message: Febrile neutropenia requires urgent assessment and interruption until recovery. NCCP calls for a lower restart dose; grade 4 may require two levels and the fourth occurrence requires cessation. Confirm grade and previous dose before calculating any restart.
action.recommendation: No dose now; establish recovery, grade, previous dose and occurrence history before restart.

action.message: Grade 4 febrile neutropenia: urgent treatment and delay until recovery. NCCP says consider a two-level reduction on restart; this is a Consultant decision, not an automatic restart prescription.

anc_x10e9_l.label: ANC
anc_x10e9_l.source_grading_note: NCCP Table 2, page 5, specifies numeric continuation and interruption thresholds without naming a CTCAE version. These are treatment-action thresholds, not CTCAE grades.
anc_x10e9_l.assessment_guidance: On treatment: ANC at least 1 ×10⁹/L AND platelets at least 100 ×10⁹/L permits the previous dose in this domain. ANC below 1 OR platelets below 100 requires delay until recovery, then review the next reduced dose level; the fourth qualifying occurrence requires cessation. Initial treatment also requires recovery from previous blood toxicity. Other entered safety concerns still govern.

platelets_x10e9_l.source_grading_note: NCCP Table 2, page 5, specifies numeric continuation and interruption thresholds without naming a CTCAE version. These are treatment-action thresholds, not CTCAE grades.

ANC below 1 OR platelets below 100 requires delay until recovery, then review the next reduced dose level; the fourth qualifying occurrence requires cessation. Initial treatment also requires recovery from previous blood toxicity. Other entered safety concerns still govern.

haematological_toxicity_occurrence_numbe.label: Haematological toxicity occurrence number
haematological_toxicity_occurrence_numbe.help: Cumulative qualifying count/FN occurrence; the fourth requires cessation. A missing number does not block an immediate count-based hold.

febrile_neutropenia.label: Febrile neutropenia
febrile_neutropenia.assessment_guidance: Use the same CTCAE v5 reference as the linked grade selector: ANC below 1 ×10⁹/L with a single temperature above 38.3°C or at least 38°C sustained for more than one hour. Urgently assess suspected sepsis; NCCP requires interruption for febrile neutropenia regardless of whether the severity selector has been completed.

febrile_neutropenia_grade.label: Febrile neutropenia grade
febrile_neutropenia_grade.help: Required only when febrile neutropenia is present.
febrile_neutropenia_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm ANC and temperature criteria, assess sepsis, haemodynamic stability, organ dysfunction and need for urgent IV antimicrobial treatment.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: ANC below 1.0 ×10⁹/L with either a single temperature above 38.3°C or at least 38.0°C sustained for more than one hour.

crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance category
crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Select the protocol-specific renal band containing the verified CrCl/eGFR/GFR. Do not estimate a band without a valid renal-function calculation.
crcl_ml_min.help: Use verified creatinine clearance, not an interchangeable unadjusted eGFR. Exact30 is a source discrepancy. Numeric input remains supported.

haemodialysis.label: Patient receiving haemodialysis
haemodialysis.help: Required only in severe renal impairment to distinguish haemodialysis.

child_pugh_class.label: Child–Pugh class
child_pugh_class.help: Optional hepatic-impairment review. Leaving this blank is recorded as an unassessed domain.

cyp3a_inhibitor_class.label: CYP3A inhibitor class
cyp3a_inhibitor_class.help: Optional interaction review. Complete when a relevant interacting medicine is present or suspected.

persistent_cytopenia_after_4_week_hold.label: Counts remain abnormal after four weeks off olaparib

intolerable_nonhaematological_toxicity.label: Intolerable nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or other toxicity

recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.label: Before initial treatment: previous blood toxicity recovered to grade 1 or better
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.help: Initial-start requirement from EMA SmPC. Do not use the less restrictive on-treatment count threshold to infer recovery.
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.grading_source_label: EMA Lynparza SmPC — initial blood-toxicity recovery
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.source_grading_note: SmPC section 4.4 requires recovery to CTCAE grade 1 or better before initial treatment, but does not name a CTCAE version here. Confirm the named cytopenia and the source grading version; generic severity anchors cannot establish recovery.
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.assessment_guidance: Before starting olaparib, confirm that haemoglobin, platelets and neutrophils have recovered from prior anticancer treatment to CTCAE grade 1 or better. A passing NCCP on-treatment ANC/platelet threshold does not establish this initial-start requirement.

residual_invasive_disease.label: Residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy

weeks_since_completion_of_last_local_or_.label: Time since last surgery, chemotherapy or radiation

hb_g_dl.label: Haemoglobin
hb_g_dl.help: Enter g/dL (divide g/L by 10). Severe or transfusion-dependent anaemia needs interruption and investigation; this is not a transfusion-prescribing calculator.
hb_g_dl.assessment_guidance: Use CTCAE v5 anaemia grading, matching the encoded Hb rules: below 8 g/dL is grade 3, 8 to below 10 g/dL is grade 2, and grade 1 requires the local lower limit of normal. Transfusion indication or life-threatening consequences can assign a higher grade. This is not a transfusion-prescribing threshold or whole-patient clearance.

weeks_since_radiotherapy.label: Time since completion of radiotherapy
weeks_since_radiotherapy.help: Use only if radiotherapy was given. Trial sequencing used at least two weeks after local therapy; review the individual plan.

treatment_phases.name: Continuous olaparib tablets
